reason: The text (Exodus 15, the Song of Moses) explicitly depicts the Hebrew people actively expressing their views. Moses and the Israelites sang (יָשִֽׁיר) and spoke (וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ לֵאמֹ֑ר - 'and they said, saying'), proclaiming their faith and praise to God for His victory and power. The passage demonstrates vocal, public expression of their beliefs and perspectives, directly contradicting any notion of discouragement from expression.
